Westerlo season | website = {{URL|https://www.kvcwesterlo.be/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _westerlo2526h | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_s1 = | leftarm1 = FFDD00 | body1 = FFFF00 | rightarm1 = FFDD00 | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = FFFF00 | pattern_la2 = _nikeprecision7mn | pattern_b2 = _nikeprecision7mn | pattern_ra2 = _nikeprecision7mn | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_s2 = | leftarm2 = 000055 | body2 = 000055 | rightarm2 = 000055 | shorts2 = 000055 | socks2 = 000055 | pattern_la3 = _nikestrike4w25 | pattern_b3 = _westerlo2526t | pattern_ra3 = _nikestrike4w25 | pattern_sh3 = _nikeleague3wb | leftarm3 = FFFFFF | body3 = FFFFFF | rightarm3 = FFFFFF | shorts3 = FFFFFF | socks3 = FFFFFF }} '''[[Koninklijk]]e Voetbal Club Westerlo''' ({{IPA|nl|ˈkoːnɪŋkləkə ˈvudbɑl ˌklʏp ˈʋɛstərloː}}; often simply called '''Westerlo''') is a Belgian professional [[Association football|football]] club located in the municipality of [[Westerlo]] in the province of [[Antwerp (province)|Antwerp]]. Since [[Belgian First Division 1997-98|1997–98]], Westerlo has been mostly playing in the [[Belgian Pro League]], save for a short stint in the [[Belgian Second Division]] between 2012 and 2014, and another between 2017 and 2022. Their highest finish is a 6th place in [[Belgian First Division 1999-2000|1999–00]], [[2003–04 Belgian First Division|2003–04]] and [[2008–09 Belgian First Division|2008–09]]. They have won one [[Belgian Cup]]. The only player who has ever been called up for the [[Belgium national football team]] while at Westerlo is [[Toni Brogno]] (7 caps, all of them while at Westerlo). The club was founded in 1933, receiving the [[Football in Belgium#Matricule numbers|matricule number]] 2024. Their colours are yellow and blue. They play their home matches at the [[Het Kuipje]]."}}
